title: US-India Satellite Captures Time-lapse Video of Volcanic Eruption
summary: Like tendrils on a vine, lava spreads out from the northern crater of Krasheninnikov, a volcano pair on the Pacific coast of Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula.
